integrity: No independent mathematical audit was performed; all proofs, code and reported numerical checks accompany the finding. The general high-half equivalence of ordinary and accurate domination is cited as known, not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers two-factor rectangular rook graphs only. Exact formulas are mathematically proved and checked on finitely many boards; the checks do not certify infinitely many parameters. Priority may be affected by unindexed equivalent work or a 2022 full text not accessible at review.
title: The accurate domination polynomial of every rectangular rook graph
